description: Create emergency plant care instructions for a neighbor who will care for 6 specialty plants during your unexpected absence. Must include: (1) Document title with date range, (2) Summary table with 6 plants showing Name/Location/Water Frequency/Special Notes, (3) Detailed sections for each plant with Heading 2 style, (4) Emergency contact information with bold formatting. This tests document structure, tables, headings, and instructional writing.
